    if not tokens:
        raise SQLSyntaxError("Unexpected EOF")
    token = tokens.pop(0)
    if token.type != expected_type or (expected_value is not None and token.value != expected_value):
        raise SQLSyntaxError(f"Expected {expected_type}{f': {expected_value}' if expected_value else ''}, got {token.type}: {token.value}")

    return ColumnDef(name_token.value, column_type)

def _parse_column_ref(tokens: list[Token]) -> ColumnRef:
    name_token = _consume_token(tokens, TokenType.IDENTIFIER)
    return ColumnRef(name_token.value)

def _parse_literal(tokens: list[Token]) -> Literal:

        return Literal(True)
    elif token.value == "FALSE":
        return Literal(False)
    elif token.value == "NULL":
        return Literal(None)
    else:
        raise SQLSyntaxError(f"Unexpected literal: {token.value}")
